containers.name: verify
command:
import json,pathlib,hashlib,sqlite3
p=pathlib.Path("/data/archives/ASTRA-pre-0055-20260906")
m=json.loads((p/"manifest.json").read_text())
assert m["integrity_check"]=="ok" and m["database_generation"]["id"]=="dbgen_finance_20260827"
assert max(x["version"] for x in m["migrations"])==54 and all(x["success"] for x in m["migrations"])
h=hashlib.sha256((p/"pharness.db").read_bytes()).hexdigest();assert m["archive_database_sha256"] in [h,"sha256:"+h]
db=sqlite3.connect("file:"+str(p/"pharness.db")+"?mode=ro",uri=True)
def quoted(name):return '"'+name.replace('"','""')+'"'
def enc(value):return {"sqlite_blob_hex":value.hex()} if isinstance(value,bytes) else value
fingerprints={}
for (name,) in db.execute("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%' ORDER BY name").fetchall():
 cols=[r[1] for r in db.execute("PRAGMA table_info("+quoted(name)+")")];fields=','.join(map(quoted,cols));h=hashlib.sha256();count=0
 for row in db.execute("SELECT "+fields+" FROM "+quoted(name)+" ORDER BY "+fields):
  h.update(json.dumps([enc(v) for v in row],ensure_ascii=False,separators=(',',':')).encode());h.update(b'\n');count+=1
 fingerprints[name]={"columns":cols,"rows":count,"sha256":h.hexdigest()}
assert db.execute("SELECT count(*) FROM work_items WHERE workflow_policy_json IS NOT NULL OR workflow_policy_hash IS NOT NULL").fetchone()[0]==0
assert all(fingerprints[t]["rows"]==0 for t in ["hosted_reconciliations","hosted_operations","hosted_operation_locks"])
print(json.dumps({"archive_path":str(p),"database_sha256":m["archive_database_sha256"],"database_bytes":(p/"pharness.db").stat().st_size,"manifest_sha256":"sha256:"+hashlib.sha256((p/"manifest.json").read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"integrity_check":m["integrity_check"],"migrations":m["migrations"],"database_generation":m["database_generation"],"table_counts":m["table_counts"],"original_column_fingerprints":fingerprints,"hosted_rows":0,"scope":"same-volume read-only source snapshot; not independent disaster recovery"}))
